description: This Java class `HttpUtils` provides a collection of utility methods for processing HTTP requests and responses within an Eclipse Hono service context. It includes methods for failing routing contexts with specific HTTP status codes and headers, extracting common HTTP header values (like content type, time to live, command response status), and writing JSON payloads to HTTP responses.

classes.name: HttpUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for HTTP request and response handling within the Eclipse Hono context. Provides error handling, header extraction, and response writing functionalities.

methods.name: badRequest
methods.description: Fails the routing context with a 400 Bad Request status, optionally including a message.

methods.name: internalServerError
methods.description: Fails the routing context with a 500 Internal Server Error status, optionally including a message.

methods.name: serviceUnavailable
methods.description: Fails the routing context with a 503 Service Unavailable status and sets the Retry-After header.

methods.name: unauthorized
methods.description: Fails the routing context with a 401 Unauthorized status and sets the WWW-Authenticate header.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Fails the routing context with a specific ServiceInvocationException error.

methods.name: failWithHeaders
methods.description: Fails the routing context with a given error and optional HTTP headers.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Type header value from the routing context.

methods.name: isEmptyNotification
methods.description: Checks if the current request contains an empty notification based on its Content-Type.

methods.name: getTimeTillDisconnect
methods.description: Extracts the 'Time Till Disconnect' value from HTTP headers or query parameters, parsed as Integer.

methods.name: getTimeToLive
methods.description: Extracts the 'Time To Live' value from HTTP headers or query parameters, parsed as Duration.

methods.name: getCommandResponseStatus
methods.description: Extracts the 'Command Response Status' from headers or query parameters, parsed as Integer and wrapped in Optional.

methods.name: setResponseBody
methods.description: Writes JSON array, JSON object, or Buffer to the HTTP response, setting appropriate headers without ending the response.
